blocks.label: Overview
bullets: 20 Grams of Protein and 9 Grams of Essential Amino Acids Per Serving
No Artificial Sweeteners, Flavors, Food Dyes, or Other Unnecessary Junk

paragraphs: Whey protein concentrate is a form of whey protein made from fresh dairy whey, which is the liquid part of milk remaining after cheese has been made. It undergoes special filtration to remove excess fat and lactose while preserving the protein content and quality.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, mix 1 serving with 8 to 10 ounces of water.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Alkalized cocoa powder, medium chain triglyceride powders (as goMCT®), natural flavor, cocoa butter buds, sea salt, xanthan gum, stevia leaf extract, steviol glycosides (rebaudioside M).
This product was produced in a facility that may also process ingredients containing soy, wheat, egg, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, fish, and crustacean shellfish.
Made in the USA with globally sourced ingredients.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.

Notice to California consumers: Consuming this product can expose you to chemicals including lead which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm. Prop 65.

Not intended for persons under the age of 18. Do not use if pregnant or nursing. Consult a health can professional prior to consumption if you have any pre-existing medical conditions or are taking any prescription medication. Improper use of this product will not improve results and is potentially hazard to a person's health. Use only as directed. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
